title: Normalized direct image and total limit on quotient systems
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and $f:X\to Y$ any morphism of schemes. Use the strict quotient-system module categories and their actual direct image $F$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Write $T_W$ for exact restriction to completed-coefficient towers followed by ordinary limit, $L_W$ for exact derived restriction followed by total derived limit, $P_f$ for ordinary completed-coefficient direct image and $RP_f$ for its total derived functor [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. There exists a LimitComparison [def-weil-strict-mixed-unit-data]: an ordinary natural isomorphism $c:F T_Y\simeq T_X P_f$ which, on every section, preserves each specified limit projection (at the base-changed site object), and a natural isomorphism $d:RF L_Y\simeq L_X RP_f$. If $u_W$ is the whole-complex total-limit unit (including exact-restriction localization factors) and $v_F,v_P$ are universal right-derived units, then for every cochain complex $A$ of quotient systems,
$$u_Y(FA);L_Y(v_F(A));d_{QA}=Q(c_A);v_P(T_XA);RP_f(u_X(A)).$$
This is the full structure StrictDirectImageMixedUnit.LimitComparison, including its ordinary sectionwise projection equations and derived-unit equation on all complexes. No properness, boundedness, constructibility or finite-type hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The completed structural map is fixed by every quotient projection [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Ordinary direct image and coefficient restriction leave sections unchanged except for precomposition by base change. A section of either ordinary composite is the same compatible tuple. Identity on tuples is linear by that structural-map equation, natural, and inverse to itself. Composing it with the nth projection gives the same section in either order.

Treat the varying quotient rings as one ring sheaf on the product site and the completed coefficient restriction as a ringed-topos morphism. Its inverse-image sheaf functor is the identity, and its module direct image is exact coefficient restriction. Total inverse limit is the direct image from the constant-ring tower topos. Both composites with geometric direct image represent the same ringed-topos map; the ordinary comparison in Step 1 identifies their structural maps. Apply the normalized unbounded composition theorem [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] successively. Exact coefficient restriction has its termwise derived functor, yielding the specified L_W, while the geometric factor gives the actual RF. The resulting composite isomorphism gives d. This does not require restriction to preserve K-injectives.

The normalizations of the compositors identify their maps on every complex with the two composites of universal units. Substitution of the total-limit unit, including the inverse exact-restriction factor, gives exactly the displayed equation. Ordinary projections were already fixed in Step 1, so c,d and these proofs form LimitComparison. Stacks sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok and lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim supply the same common-pushforward calculation.
